model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of a variance decomposition across different categories. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled "Health and Nutrition," "Logistics," "Personal Finance," "Travel and Transportation," and "MVS," with each category rotated 45 degrees. The vertical axis is labeled "1-MVS" and spans from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear increments of 0.2. Each category has a bar composed of two stacked sections; the lower section is consistently colored green and is labeled "70B llama," while the upper section is colored a shade of purple and labeled "SS llama." The 70B llama section of each bar ranges from approximately 0.6 to 0.7, while the SS llama section ranges from approximately 0.2 to 0.4. Bars are arranged in an order corresponding to the category labels. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotation.
